contentList.content: Once per turn, make an <LSTag Tooltip="OpportunityAttack">opportunity attack</LSTag> against a creature that enters your reach, without spending a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">Reaction</LSTag>.
If you are Human, you can also shield an ally next to you without spending a Reaction. If you haven't moved this turn, gain +[1] Armour Class until the start of your next turn.
Attack a creature that enters your reach.
